description: Use this whenever the user asks which local or open-weight LLM is best, overall or for coding, documents or decisions, or which model they can run on their graphics card (VRAM) or Mac. Returns tested models ranked by our own test scores, best first; with a GPU or Mac memory size it only returns models that fit, plus the quantization to download and the memory it needs. Examples: 'best model for a 16 GB GPU', 'best coding model on a 32 GB Mac', 'best small model under 10B'.

max_params_b.description: Only models with at most this many billion parameters.

memory_gb.description: VRAM or Mac memory in GB. Needs hardware.

sort_by.description: Score to rank by. Default overall.

name: find_models
title: Find the best models for a task or computer
